Commentary.Commentary: Bad news, folks! The 3rd T20I between South Africa and Zimbabwe has been called off. This was on the cards after the amount of rain we witnessed. So, the white-ball series between Zimbabwe and South Africa has come to an end. The hosts clean sweep Zimbabwe in the 50-over format and the T20Is. They were not clinical by any means but got the job done. The Proteas fielded some new faces during the tour and they did the job for them. The one player who benefited the most from this Zimbabwean tour was Imran Tahir. The leggie was not at his best earlier but he turned it around and came out with flying colors to gain the Man of the Series awards in both ODIs and T20Is. For the tourists, their bowlers were on the money but their batters let them down on most occasions. This is one area the African minnows would like to focus more on. Right then, that's all from us here. South Africa now will travel to Australia for their next assignment while Zimbabwe will head to Bangladesh for an ODI and Test series. We hope to see you again for those games. Till then, thank you!
